title: Page 60
transc:
Dept & command simply an active
tappan in the field my responsibility
for the safety of the line
of the Grub & the states
north of it must terminate the
moment I talbot so far beyond
that line as to adopt another
for my base of operations The
question for the Quarrel in Chf
to decide & which I regard
as beyond my province is this
first shall the safety of Harpers
Ferry & the line of the
Grunt be regarded as assured by
the talbot of the Tappan south
of the Blue ridge & the
line left to take care of
its self second If it is
deemed necessary to hold the line
or that here in before indicated
in talbot of it how many
stanhope shall be placed there at
what points & in what numbers
& of what composition at each
